verdict.rationale: incident.io documents Workflows that automatically perform actions when events occur, for example auto-publishing to a status page when an incident is updated. It also documents conditional escalation rules based on priority and working hours, alert routing by team or service, and bi-directional ticket sync that updates on changes. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the workflow rule engine (trigger types, condition logic, available action catalog), AI-native rule authoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.
